type: amendment to combo_test.json, decided on selection data (C-RET) before stage 2 and before C-INT is opened; user decision 2026-10-31 ("do the assembly fix first")
finding_that_motivated_it: Descriptive analysis of RQ2-v2 per-question data (C-RET, 567 q): production hierarchical assembly stops at the first parent that does not fit the 1,600-token budget. 48% of contexts end with < 5 units and < 1,400 tokens; their CEC@0.5 is 0.690 against 0.770 for the rest. No answer-quality result for the change exists.

change.name: fill
change.rule: Hierarchical assembly as production (rank order, deduplicated parents, +-200-word windowing for parents > 800 tokens, <= 5 units, 1,600 est. tokens), except that a parent that does not fit the remaining budget is skipped and assembly continues down the ranking, instead of stopping. The first parent is always included, as today.
change.unchanged: chunks, embeddings, ranking, windowing, budget, unit cap, gate rule (max dense score of the matched children of the parents in the context), prompt
change.production_switch: settings.RAG_CONTEXT_FILL (default False). It is set True only if stage 2 selects a pipeline that uses fill, before the RQ6 config is frozen.

step_1_retrieval_check.role: descriptive only (confirms the change does what it should; not a decision)
step_1_retrieval_check.data: C-RET (QASPER v0.3 Train, 335 papers / 567 questions); pymupdf_layout, hierarchical 200/40, e5-small-v2 dense (cached vectors)
step_1_retrieval_check.measures: context tokens, units, early-stop rate, CEC@0.3/0.5/0.7, budgeted nDCG@10; fill - stop paired paper-cluster bootstrap B=10,000 seed 42

step_2_stage2.change_to_stage2: One extra pipeline, pymupdf_layout|hierarchical|e5|dense+fill (gate 0.80, the e5 rule), added to the combined shortlist. All other pipelines keep production assembly.
step_2_stage2.rule: unchanged stage-2 rule: a pair replaces the production pair only with Token F1 >= +0.03, CI lower bound > 0, Holm p < 0.05, end-to-end P50 <= 1.5x production; several pass -> highest F1
step_2_stage2.note: the fill pipeline goes through the same successive halving as every other pipeline

if_selected: Production sets RAG_CONTEXT_FILL=True before the RQ6 config is frozen; RQ6 then confirms the shipped system on C-INT.
known_before_registration: Only the descriptive RQ2-v2 finding above. No result with fill on any data.
